fact: Car 6 was driven in a manner that was regarded as erratic following an incident involving Car 23 at Turn1
offence: Breach of Article B1.8.5 of the FIA F1 Regulations.
reason: The Stewards heard from the driver of Car 6 (Isack Hadjar), the team representative of Car 6 and reviewed video evidence. On the approach to Turn 1, Car 23 moved to the outside of the corner on the approach of Car 6, to avoid any impeding of that car. The driver of Car 6 locked brakes and had to abort the lap. He was obviously upset with this and took what could be described as "retaliatory action" by swerving towards Car 23. The Stewards regard this as not only erratic but also an action that should be discouraged and hence impose the penalty of a warning to the driver. Had the action been dangerous or resulted in a collision, a more severe penalty would have been imposed.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
